sources.title: Supplied policy: manager must approve before ordering

workflows.name: Unnamed process (request / manager approval / ordering)
setupNotes: No workflow.yaml was supplied to this review; the design was described only in prose (request and ordering run in parallel).

decisions.question: Ordering runs in parallel with request, so it is not gated on the manager-approval decision. The supplied policy requires manager approval before ordering. How should the design be corrected: move ordering out of the parallel group and add a predecessor on the approval decision's 'approve' outcome, or restructure differently? Also: does the current parallel branch have a reject/return path, and what should happen to an order already placed in parallel if approval is later rejected?
